items.title: OpenAI used GPT-6 Astra for physics
items.oneliner: OpenAI says GPT-6 Astra helped prove a Standard Model construction. Frontier models are inching from coding into real research.

items.title: Apple launched a massive AI health study
items.oneliner: Apple opened a 200,000-person AI health study app. Consumer distribution is becoming a serious moat for medical AI data.

items.title: OpenAI opened models to outside assessors
items.oneliner: OpenAI gave four outside groups internal model access for embedded assessments. Safety evaluation is getting closer to audit, not PR.

items.title: uBlock Origin had a universal XSS flaw
items.oneliner: A website-driven uBlock Origin bug enabled universal XSS across sites. Browser extensions remain a dangerously privileged attack surface.

items.title: Linux TCP bug can remotely crash servers
items.oneliner: NoisyTCP lets attackers corrupt Linux TCP state and knock over Nginx or Apache. Default stacks are still one packet away from pain.

items.title: One bad MCP server can hijack agents
items.oneliner: A compromised MCP server made agents misuse trusted tools 78.3% of the time. Tool trust is now the real agent perimeter.

items.title: Congress is targeting remote access to compute
items.oneliner: Congress is reviving rules to block China's remote access to overseas AI compute. Export controls are shifting from chips to usage.

items.title: Nvidia faces China scrutiny and supply pressure
items.oneliner: Nvidia's China exposure is under fire as rivals and cloud customers build alternatives. The AI hardware monopoly looks less permanent.

items.title: Rust enabled its parallel frontend by default
items.oneliner: Rust nightly now enables the parallel frontend by default, with some benchmarks up to 3x faster. Compiler parallelism is finally shipping.

items.title: Microsoft traced its email outage to a fix
items.oneliner: Microsoft says a July fix triggered lock contention that left over 80% of email servers unresponsive. Reliability debt compounds quietly.
